errors.createRoom: An error occurred while creating the room. Error: {{message}}

compaction.tooltipDescription: Summarizes the conversation history to free up space in the context window. The full history remains visible above the compaction divider.
compaction.suggestionDescription: This conversation is using a significant portion of the context window. Compacting will summarize the history to keep things running smoothly.
compaction.confirmDescription: This will summarize your conversation history to free up space in the context window. The AI will continue from a condensed summary rather than the full transcript. Your complete history will still be visible above the compaction divider.

contextWindow.descriptionLow: All conversations have a limit. Very long conversations will eventually cause the model to forget earlier messages.
contextWindow.descriptionMedium: This conversation is getting long. If it continues, the model will start forgetting earlier messages. Consider starting a new chat soon.
contextWindow.descriptionHigh: This conversation is nearly full. The model will soon start forgetting earlier messages. Consider starting a new chat.
contextWindow.descriptionExceeded: This conversation has exceeded its limit. The model is now forgetting earlier messages when generating responses. Start a new chat for best results.
